basic_info.name: الجامعة الهاشمية
basic_info.establishment_note: Royal decree issued June 19, 1991; teaching began 1995

admission_requirements.general_requirements: Tawjihi (General Secondary Education Certificate) or equivalent; international students submit equivalent secondary credentials certified by Jordanian Ministry of Education
admission_requirements.exam_details: Selective admission based on entrance examinations and students' past academic records and grades
admission_requirements.english_requirement: Varies by program; TOEFL or IELTS required for postgraduate programs

tuition_fees.notes: Tuition varies by program and student type. Fee schedules available as PDFs on the Financial Affairs Unit page: Bachelor's (local/international), Diploma, Master's, Doctoral (Arabic), and Medical Specialization programs. International bachelor's: 1,800-6,000 JOD/year. Local students pay approximately 2,500 JOD/year equivalent. Specific per-credit-hour fees depend on college and program.

ranking_accreditation.accreditation: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research of Jordan, ABET (Engineering), Higher Education Accreditation Commission (HEAC), American Medical Residency Certification Board
ranking_accreditation.international_recognition: QS World University Rankings #1001-1200 (2027), THE World University Rankings #1001-1200 (2026), US News Best Global Universities #1346, QS Arab Region Rankings #51

campus_facilities.accommodation_details: Student housing (مبنى المدينة الجامعية) available primarily for female international students with full services including transportation, internet, security, and study atmosphere
campus_facilities.library_details: Hashemite University Library with electronic/digital library platform (DeepKnowledge)
campus_facilities.scholarship_details: Financial aid and scholarships available for both local and international students; university offers financial support programs
